name: Parish Pass
applePromotionalText: Find local businesses, follow your favorites, explore community events and collect participating businesses' rewards—all in Parish Pass.
googleShortDescription: Discover local businesses, events and rewards. Connect with your community.
description:
Discover the businesses and experiences that make your community yours. Parish Pass brings local business discovery, events and participating businesses' rewards into one app.

EXPLORE YOUR COMMUNITY
Browse business pages, photos, menus and services. Find nearby businesses and published mobile business stops. Follow your favorites to stay connected and discover what they share.

MAKE PLANS AND COME BACK
Explore local events, RSVP and set reminders. Join participating businesses' loyalty programs and keep track of available rewards. Read customer reviews and share your experience.

CONNECT WITH LOCAL BUSINESSES
Send service requests and contact businesses through their pages. Participating businesses can offer pickup ordering and appointment bookings when supported payment setup is available. Features, rewards, events and commerce options depend on the business and your location.

TOOLS FOR BUSINESS OWNERS
Create a hosted business page and manage your profile, photos, menu or services, events and mobile locations. Business subscriptions offer three feature-based plans, each covering up to three businesses:
• Essentials: business hosting, discovery, service requests and basic activity insights.
• Growth: Essentials plus loyalty rewards, follower updates and staff scanning.
• Pro: Growth plus pickup ordering and appointment booking tools with supported payment setup.

Customer account and discovery features are free. Business owner tools require a paid, auto-renewing subscription. Review the current price, billing period and included features in the app before purchase. Manage or cancel subscriptions through your device's purchasing store. Purchases of goods or services from businesses and payment processing fees are separate. A subscription does not guarantee business approval, customer reach or sales.

Optional location and notifications support nearby discovery, reminders and mobile business alerts. Nearby alerts can use background location when enabled; you control these permissions in device settings.
